title: clsx
description: A tiny utility for constructing className strings conditionally.

data.text: clsx is a tiny, fast utility for conditionally joining class names. It handles strings, objects, and arrays, making it ideal for dynamic styling in React and other frameworks.

data.title: Installation
data.code:
npm install clsx
# or
yarn add clsx

data.title: Conditional Classes
Bundle Size
data.text: clsx is only ~100 bytes gzipped, making it one of the lightest class utility options.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: It supports objects, arrays, and strings
data.takeaway: clsx is the simplest way to manage dynamic CSS classes.
